name: Schema.org Lodging
description: Adds Schema.org lodging-industry structured data (Hotel, B&B, VacationRental) via Schema.org Metatag.
project_description:
This project extends Drupal's Schema.org Metatag module to display lodging related structured data as JSON LD in the head of web pages. 

 Features 
 Provides schema.org properties for: 

 
 LodgingBusiness 
 
 
 BedAndBreakfast [todo]
 Campground [todo]
 Hostel [todo]
 Hotel
 Motel [todo]
 Resort[todo]
 VacationRental
 
 
 Contribution on [todo] are welcome.

 Post-Installation 
 Additional Requirements 
 This module depends on https://www.drupal.org/project/schema_metatag 

This module works with https://www.drupal.org/project/bee_hotel 

 Supporting this Module 
 You can support this module with code and/or donations
